poke_ball.name: Poké Ball
poke_ball.desc:
A BALL thrown to catch a wild
POKéMON. It is designed in a
capsule style.

great_ball.name: Great Ball
great_ball.desc:
A good, quality BALL that offers
a higher POKéMON catch rate than
a standard POKé BALL.

ultra_ball.name: Ultra Ball
ultra_ball.desc:
A very high-grade BALL that offers
a higher POKéMON catch rate than
a GREAT BALL.

potion.name: Potion
potion.desc:
A spray-type wound medicine.
It restores the HP of one POKéMON
by 20 points.

super_potion.name: Super Potion
super_potion.desc:
A spray-type wound medicine.
It restores the HP of one POKéMON
by 50 points.

hyper_potion.name: Hyper Potion
hyper_potion.desc:
A spray-type wound medicine.
It restores the HP of one POKéMON
by 200 points.

max_potion.name: Max Potion
max_potion.desc:
A spray-type wound medicine.
It fully restores the HP of one
POKéMON.

full_restore.name: Full Restore
full_restore.desc:
A medicine that fully restores the
HP and heals any status problems
of one POKéMON.

revive.name: Revive
revive.desc:
A medicine that revives a fainted
POKéMON, restoring HP by half the
maximum amount.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.desc:
A spray-type medicine.
It heals one POKéMON from a
poisoning.

paralyze_heal.name: Parlyz Heal
paralyze_heal.desc:
A spray-type medicine.
It heals one POKéMON from
paralysis.

awakening.name: Awakening
awakening.desc:
A spray-type medicine.
It awakens a sleeping POKéMON.

burn_heal.name: Burn Heal
burn_heal.desc:
A spray-type medicine.
It heals one POKéMON of a burn.

ice_heal.name: Ice Heal
ice_heal.desc:
A spray-type medicine.
It defrosts a frozen POKéMON.

full_heal.name: Full Heal
full_heal.desc:
A spray-type medicine.
It heals all the status problems of
one POKéMON.

end_portal.note: frames are 128x128 and tile: draw cell (x, y) from (x*16 mod 128, y*16 mod 128) of the frame

dragon.heading0: east, clockwise on screen (4 south, 8 west, 12 north)
dragon.note: origin is the ground point under the body when it stands; a flying frame is drawn altitude px higher, its shadow at the ground point

crystal.note: draw the centre about 22 px above the pillar-top point, bobbing (Minecraft: sin(age * 0.2) / 2 + 0.5)

body.heading0: east, clockwise on screen (4 south, 8 west, 12 north)
body.armor: wither_armor.png: same layout; draw it over the body with globalCompositeOperation lighter (spawn rows are blank)
body.note: origin is the ground point under it (the model hovers with its tail tip about 6 px up); draw a flying frame altitude px higher and its shadow at the ground point; heads are the head centres per heading in frame pixels (row float0), where the skulls start

beam.scroll: Minecraft scrolls the texture by -(time * 0.2) blocks a tick: about 64 px a second upward

beaconScreen.note: BeaconScreen's layout (gui_beacon is 256x256, the window is its top-left 230x219)

primary.note: level 1: 2 buttons centred around x 76 (24 px apart) at y 22, level 2 at y 47, level 3: 1 at y 72

secondary.note: level 4: regeneration and the primary at II, 24 px apart
